description: This file contains shell functions related to handling filesystem images, including extracting magic words, determining filesystem types like ubifs or squashfs, and calculating aligned sizes.

methods.name: get_magic_word
methods.description: Reads the first 4 bytes of a file and outputs their hexadecimal representation.

methods.name: get_post_padding_word
methods.description: Retrieves the post-padding word at the end of a filesystem image, used to identify certain filesystem types.

methods.name: get_fs_type
methods.description: Determines the filesystem type (e.g., ubifs, squashfs, squashfs-jffs2, unknown) based on the magic word and post-padding marker.

methods.name: round_up
methods.description: Calculates the smallest multiple of a given number that is greater than or equal to a specified value.
